controls.label: Ring radius
controls.serializedMeaning: Radius of the single circular tray before projection.
controls.causalObservation: All card centres move radially while angular identity, phase, source ratio, and front gate stay unchanged.
controls.ownershipReason: The tray radius is primary Scene geometry.

controls.label: Plane tilt
controls.serializedMeaning: Pitch of the one ring plane toward camera.
controls.causalObservation: Vertical projection and depth amplitude change coherently; angular spacing and source pixels do not.
controls.ownershipReason: Defines the ring projection, not Look lighting.

controls.label: Card size
controls.serializedMeaning: Card width before source ratio and collision adaptation.
controls.causalObservation: Outer card bounds and overlap change while centres, phase, depth order, and source ratios remain fixed.
controls.ownershipReason: Controls readable density of this spatial composition.
